title: Fix approval panel actor note not showing 'already approved this gate' for actor who already approved
goal: Ensure that when the actor-input value changes, Mission Control re-renders with the current actor. The actorAlreadyDecided check is purely client-side so it does not need an API re-fetch — it just needs to re-render the approval panel with the updated state.actor. Check whether the actor-input change event triggers a re-render of Mission Control. If not, add a state.actor change listener that calls renderMissionControl() or equivalent.
scope: test_pending_approval_run_guides_actor_switch_for_second_approver fails with 'AssertionError: Locator expected to contain text already approved this gate'. The test: (1) seeds a dual-approval LAN run (intrusive-lan-credential-capture, requires 2 approvals), (2) posts an approval as 'approver-1' with step_id='intrusive-lan-poisoning', (3) loads the page, sets actor to 'approver-1' via actor-input, switches to execution phase, (4) expects run-approval-actor-note to contain 'already approved this gate'. But the note shows the default text instead. The currentActorApproval function in mission-control.js looks for an approval matching both the current actor name (case-insensitive) AND the run.approval_step_id. The test approves with step_id='intrusive-lan-poisoning' and the run profile sets approval_step_id='intrusive-lan-poisoning'. The issue may be that the run is re-fetched from the API but the approvals array is not included in the response, OR that state.actor is not 'approver-1' when Mission Control renders.
